I’m fixing both read paths and keeping the existing reference format.

item.text:
Completed the annual report and split checkout flows.

The report now totals payments through the payments module’s effective-payment API. Checkout now recognizes split bookings when checking whole-payment retries and reservation reclamation, so an existing split prevents a duplicate booking.

Verified with `bun test`: all 3 tests passed, including the existing happy-path test and new coverage for rejected payments, split retries, and reservation reclamation.
